verdicts.reason: A is broken. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow sits stranded at the bottom left, far below the headline it introduces. The orange divider floats orphaned under the logo block. The body copy is nearly as large as the headline's supporting role allows, while the CTA button is tiny and its label is hard to read. 'Ships late June' is cut off from the button, and the legal text is squeezed into an unreadable narrow column. The bottom row reads as scattered fragments. B keeps the brand header band and a clear two-column structure with the eyebrow, headline and divider on the left and the body, CTA and ship note on the right, all grouped correctly. Its flaws: a large dead band between the content and the legal line, the divider is left hanging with nothing below it, the right column starts lower than the headline instead of sharing its top edge, and the legal line runs the full width as near-illegible fine print.
